title: The Ancient Magus' Bride
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Chise Hatori, an orphaned and rejected Japanese teenager, is sold at a London auction to Elias Ainsworth, a skull-headed fae magus who takes her as his apprentice and future bride. Chise is a 'Sleigh Beggy', whose great magic shortens her life. In the English countryside she learns magic among fae, dragons and witches, while the sorcerer Cartaphilus works gruesome experiments.
life_message: It holds up finding a home and one's own worth after rejection, and learning to care and be cared for.

content.note: Cartaphilus's grisly experiments on humans and fae; Elias turns monstrous in anger (Wikipedia; level to verify).
Dark fae, black magic and chimera horror (Wikipedia; to verify).
A teen 'bride' to an ancient being; ANN flags power and consent issues; no explicit content noted (Wikipedia; AniList Age Gap 60%).
Chise's mother tried to strangle her then died by suicide in front of her; bullying and neglect; Chise's low self-worth (Wikipedia; AniList Bullying signal).
